$comment: Relic tiers and relics per league (docs/leagues.md), used by plugins/modes/LeagueRelics.plugin.js. Costs, names, effects and granted items are the Wiki's (Trailblazer_Reloaded_League/Relics, Raging_Echoes_League/Relics), and `requiresBank` is set only where the Wiki says the relic must be unlocked in a bank (every Trailblazer Reloaded item relic; Raging Echoes' Clue Compass, Bank Heist and Fairy's Flight, while its tier-1 tools are handed out anywhere, as the Leagues V tutorial's Animal Wrangler unlock in osrs-captures 227/00196 shows); the descriptions condense the Wiki's bullets in the cache's own style. `grants` names ItemIdentifiers; a relic whose item is no longer in this cache (Trailblazer Reloaded's Sage's greaves, Trailblazer tools, crystal of memories and guardian horn; Raging Echoes' Sage's greaves and guardian horn) grants nothing and says so in `_missing`. The client draws the catalog from structs and enums the server sends (structOverrides/enumOverrides, GamemodeContentStore): `virtualIdBase` + leagueType x 1000 is where this league's ids start, and `iconStructs` are the rev 241 cache's own relic structs (enums 5703-5710, the current league's), whose icon params (881-884, 1853, 1854) are reused per tier and slot since older leagues' icons are not in the cache. Params: 870 tier enum on the league struct, 877 cost, 878 relic enum and 2045 passive struct on a tier struct, 1020 passive text, 879 name, 880 description, 885 tier index, 1855 has-item on a relic struct.
_iconStructs: The cache's tier 7 enum (5709) holds only two relics, so its third slot borrows the first's icon.

effects._comment: The relics with effects here (one <Relic>.LeagueRelics.js each), each gated on its league (`league`, one type or several for a relic both leagues have) and on being chosen (`key`, plus `aliases` for a catalog entry that stands in for the same relic). Numbers are the Wiki's: no rsprox recording of Trailblazer Reloaded exists (the captures start at revision 223). Superior Sorcerer's splash reach (one tile around the primary target, like a burst) and Undying Retribution's graphic (the Retribution prayer's, 437) are ours; the Wiki gives neither.

undyingRetribution._recoilImmuneExceptions: Wiki: it still works on these though they are immune to recoil damage (Nex, the Hespori, Vorkath and every Wilderness boss).

effects._combatComment: The combat and XP relics (docs/leagues.md). Wiki numbers unless marked ours: Archer's Embrace and Brawler's Resolve halve the weapon's speed (above 4 rounded down, below 3 rounded up, so 3, 4 and 5 all become 2). Ours: Archer's extra projectile spends no ammunition and shows no projectile (a second hitsplat); Soul Stealer's venator bow bounces make its first hit a multi-target launch (the Wiki lets the first hit restore); Weapon Master's 25-hitpoint sacrifice needs more than 25 hitpoints; Executioner's reach is the relic page's 5/7 (the Sage's axe item page says 6/8, the later Demonic Pacts version) and the axe flies as a rune thrown axe (no spotanim of its own in the cache); Last Stand refuses food and undoes any other heal a tick later, and its closing heal is the damage dealt in the window capped at the max; Equilibrium's 20% goes to the first of equally least-experienced skills.
effects._gatheringComment: The gathering relics (docs/leagues.md). Wiki numbers unless marked ours: Trickster's and Animal Wrangler's faster box-trap lure (the trap's 5-tick look for prey halved to 2 ticks: the Wiki gives no figure); the Echo tools' toggles cycle through their modes with our messages; Power Miner's auto-smelt follows its smeltBars conversions and waives other ingredients (iron becomes steel without coal; coal stays coal), its four ores a rock are counted per rock for everyone who mines it and do not count mining gloves (not modelled here); a Fishing second chance lands the best fish the player can catch at the spot; Trickster's and Dodgy Deals' coins are multiplied as coin pouches; Corner Cutter's 25% is on the lap's completion bonus; the Sage's greaves of Trickster and Corner Cutter are not in this cache.

modeText.smelt and cut: smelt the ore and cut the gems you mine
modeText.off: leave what you mine as it is

modeText.fletch: fletch the logs you chop into arrow shafts
modeText.off: leave the logs as they are

modeText.cook: cook half of what you catch

effects._productionComment: The production relics (docs/leagues.md). Wiki numbers unless marked ours: 'all at once' is up to 28 a cycle (the inventory's slots: ours) and the ammunition kinds 10 (Production Master, Wiki); the +12 is invisible (it counts where the skills check their level; the Wiki does not say); the extra product is the same amount the action made; the fletching 'chisel' group also cuts kebbit and antler bolts and wolfbone arrowtips, batched with the bolt tips (ours); the Forager's pouch keeps its own herbs (live shares the herb sack's), pays the herb's cleaning XP for a find (the Wiki: 'a small amount'), and its Herblore perks need only the relic, not the pouch carried (the Raging Echoes page does not tie them to it).

friendlyForager._saving: Wiki: the torstol potion (unf) of super combat potions and anti-venom+ is saved like a secondary; crystal dust (divine potions) never is.

effects._economyComment: The economy and farming relics (docs/leagues.md). Wiki numbers unless marked ours: what a coin shop sells comes noted whenever it can be (the Wiki's toggle has no button in this shop interface: ours, always on); the coins offering repeats at the bone altars' own pace; Farmer's Fortune's 25 times faster harvesting is 25 picks an action, its tripled yield keeps the usual Farming XP per pick (the Wiki gives no XP rule), and its kept seed's message is ours; Pocket Kingdom's approval is held at the kingdom's maximum (127, 100%), and its Check wording is ours.
effects._cluesSlayerComment: The clue and Slayer relics (docs/leagues.md). Wiki numbers unless marked ours: each of an NPC's clue scrolls comes at least 1 time in 15 (the Wiki: 'a 1/15 chance to drop one'); Treasure Seeker's bonus casket chances (bonusCasket, 1 in N by the opened tier) and its 1 in 4 upgrade are ours (the Wiki: 'more common at lower tiers', no numbers); Bloodthirsty's superior Slayer points (5 plus a fifth of the Slayer requirement) are ours; Slayer Master's bonus XP runs in a straight line from 1,000 at Slayer level 1 to 15,000 at 99 (ours).

bloodthirsty._uniqueTable: Wiki, Bloodthirsty Nechryarch: one roll on this table, out of 315.

effects._itemsComment: The item and teleport relics (docs/leagues.md). Wiki numbers unless marked ours: the menus' grouping and wording, the tool leprechauns named after their nearest fairy ring, the banker's note's default quantities (all) and its Toggle (Activate between noting and unnoting) are ours; Reloaded's extra pick comes from tiers 1-3 (tier indexes 0-2).

6._comment: Leagues VI - Demonic Pacts is the league this cache (rev 241) carries: its tiers, costs, passives and relics are read from the league struct (6436, enum 2670) and sent as nothing; no relic hands out an item, since the cache does not say which do.

tiers.passive:
- Items from eligible sources will be 2x as common.

- Run energy is never drained whilst running.

- All clue scrolls will drop as stackable scroll boxes, limited to steps in unlocked regions.

relics.name: Endless Harvest
relics.description:
- Fishing, Woodcutting and Mining resources are doubled, with bonus XP.

- Gathered resources go to your bank, or your inventory when the bank is full.

relics.name: Production Prodigy
relics.description:
- Crafting, Smithing, Herblore, Fletching and Cooking are boosted by +12.

- Processing actions handle all items at once with full XP.

- 25% chance of an extra product, sent to your bank.

relics.name: Trickster
relics.description:
- Thieving, Agility, Hunter and Firemaking always succeed.

- Your coin pouch holds three times as much and you pickpocket again automatically, for doubled, noted loot.

- Box traps lure faster with double loot and XP, impling jars never break, and you can burn up to nine logs at once.

- Grants Sage's greaves, which give Agility XP while you run.
relics._missing: Sage's greaves are not in this cache.

tiers.passive:
- League XP multiplier increased from 5x to 8x.

- Minigame points received are boosted by 3x.

relics.name: Fairy's Flight
relics.description: - Grants a fairy mushroom that teleports you to any fairy ring, spirit tree or tool leprechaun in your unlocked regions.

relics.name: Globetrotter
relics.description: - Grants a globetrotter pendant that teleports you to every ornate jewellery box destination and nearly every spellbook teleport in your unlocked regions.

relics.name: Crystal of Memories
relics.description:
- Grants a crystal of memories that returns you to where you last teleported from.

- Its cooldown of 6 minutes falls by 1 minute per 300 total levels.
relics._missing: The crystal of memories is not in this cache.
relics._note: The Wiki lists the crystal as the tier 3 passive; the tier's two relics are Banker's Note and Fire Sale, so this third slot is left for it to keep three choices a tier.

tiers.passive: - Grants a crystal of memories, which teleports you back to the last place you teleported from.

relics.name: Banker's Note
relics.description: - Grants a banker's note: use an item on it to note or unnote it, or Activate it to convert a chosen quantity at once.

relics.name: Fire Sale
relics.description:
- Every coin shop with a standard interface sells for free, and can note what you buy.

- Shops no longer buy items for gold.

relics.name: Treasure Seeker
relics.description:
- NPCs that drop clues have a 1 in 15 chance to drop one, including impling jars.

- Clue scrolls have the fewest steps and reward caskets roll the most rewards.
relics._note: Tier 5's Treasure Seeker, shown here as the third choice to keep three a tier; the Wiki lists only two tier 3 relics.

tiers.passive:
- Items from eligible sources will be 3x as common.

- Bigger and Badder is unlocked, and superior slayer monsters spawn 1 in 50.

- Slayer point rewards are 5x, with no minimum task streak.

relics.name: Archer's Embrace
relics.description:
- Ranged weapons attack twice as fast.

- Ranged accuracy is doubled, with a 10% chance of an extra projectile.

- 90% of ammunition is saved (98% with Ava's devices) and enchanted bolts proc twice as often.

relics.name: Brawler's Resolve
relics.description:
- Melee weapons attack twice as fast.

- Melee accuracy and all defences are increased by 50%, with a 10% chance to deal double damage.

- 90% of weapon charges are saved and you are immune to status effects from NPCs and players.

relics.name: Superior Sorcerer
relics.description:
- Magic weapons attack at speed 2 (1.2 seconds).

- Magic accuracy is increased by 175% and magic damage by 20%.

- 90% of runes and powered staff charges are saved.

- In multicombat, magic attacks hit up to 5 surrounding targets for up to 25% of the damage dealt.

- Binding spells always hit unless the target is immune or already bound.

- Grants an arcane grimoire and a rune pouch.

tiers.passive:
- League XP multiplier increased from 8x to 12x.

- Minigame points received are boosted by 5x.

relics.name: Treasure Seeker
relics.description:
- NPCs that drop clues have a 1 in 15 chance to drop one, including impling jars, and clue vessels are 10x as common.

- Clue scrolls have the fewest steps and reward caskets roll the most rewards, with a chance of another casket.

relics.name: Bloodthirsty
relics.description:
- Slayer tasks can be taken and cancelled remotely.

- Expeditious bracelets and bracelets of slaughter proc 35% of the time without using charges.

- Superior slayer monsters spawn 1 in 25 with extra drops, and may spawn as bloodthirsty variants.

relics.name: Infernal Gathering
relics.description: - Grants the Trailblazer axe, pickaxe and harpoon, which burn, smelt and cook what you gather for XP and work a tick faster.
relics._missing: The Trailblazer tools are not in this cache.

tiers.passive: - Items from eligible sources will be 4x as common.

relics.name: Equilibrium
relics.description: - Every XP gain also gives XP equal to 10% of your total level (20% for your lowest skill), not multiplied by the league rate.

relics.name: Farmer's Fortune
relics.description:
- 20% chance to keep a planted seed or sapling.

- Patches grow instantly and never get diseased.

- Harvesting is 25x faster, with triple, noted yield.

relics.name: Ruinous Powers
relics.description: - Grants the Ruinous Powers book, which switches between the standard and Ruinous Powers prayer books.

tiers.passive:

relics.name: Berserker
relics.description:
- Damage dealt is increased by 0.4% for each hitpoint you are missing.

- You always hit your max hit on an NPC with full health.

relics.name: Soul Stealer

relics.name: Weapon Master
relics.description:
- Special attacks always hit NPCs, for at least 20% of your max hit.

tiers.passive: - Items from eligible sources will be 5x as common.

relics.name: Executioner
relics.description: - Grants Sage's axe, a thrown weapon that executes targets below 20% of their hitpoints.

relics.name: Undying Retribution
relics.description:
- Upon death your hitpoints and prayer are fully restored, and every enemy within three tiles takes up to 200% of your Prayer level in damage (50% for other players).

- Works wherever Retribution does, once every three minutes.

relics.name: Guardian
relics.description: - Grants the guardian horn, which summons a guardian thrall for 30 minutes that attacks with the style its target is weakest to.

relics.name: Power Miner
relics.description:
- Grants the Echo pickaxe.

- Failed mining swings get a second 50% chance, ore goes to your bank, and rocks last for four ores.

- Ore can be smelted and gems cut as you mine.

relics.name: Lumberjack
relics.description:
- Grants the Echo axe.

- Failed chops get a second 50% chance and logs go to your bank.

- Logs can be burnt or fletched into arrow shafts as you chop.

relics.name: Animal Wrangler
relics.description:
- Grants the Echo harpoon, which fishes a tick faster and acts as every fishing tool.

- Failed catches get a second 50% chance, fish go to your bank and half are cooked on the spot.

tiers.passive: - League XP multiplier increased from 5x to 8x.

relics.name: Corner Cutter
relics.description:

relics.description:

- Secondary ingredients have a 90% chance not to be used, and potions are made with 4 doses.

relics.name: Dodgy Deals
relics.description:
- Pickpocketing hits every matching NPC within 5 tiles, always succeeds, repeats itself and notes the loot.
